description:
Creates Meeting Topic.

#### Uploading attachments
To upload attachments you must upload the entire payload as `multipart/form-data` content-type and
specify each parameter as form-data together with `attachments[]` as files.

schema.description: A single agenda or minutes item within a Meeting, organized under a meeting category.

id.description: Unique identifier for this meeting topic. Use as the `{id}` path parameter to update the topic via `/rest/v1.0/meeting_topics/{id}`.

number.description: Human-readable outline number for the topic, combining its category and position (for example `1.1`).

created_on.description: Date the topic was created, in the project's time zone.

position.description: Zero-based ordering of this topic within its meeting category; lower values sort first.

due_date.description: Date by which the topic is expected to be resolved. Null when no due date is set.

priority.description: Priority assigned to the topic. Constrained to the values in the enum; an empty string means no priority.

status.description: Workflow state of the topic. Constrained to the values in the enum.

minutes.description: Rich-text (HTML) meeting minutes recorded for this topic.

description.description: Plain-text description of the topic, with any rich-text markup stripped.

meeting_category.description: The category this topic is grouped under within the Meeting.

title.description: Display name of the meeting category.

assignments.description: Project users assigned responsibility for this topic.

id.description: Login Information (user) identifier of the assignee.

login.description: Email address the assignee signs in with.

name.description: Full display name of the assignee.
Display name of the attached file.

filename.description: Original file name of the attachment (same value as `name`).

url.description: Download URL for the attached file.

project_id.description: Identifier of the Project the Meeting belongs to. Must reference a Project the caller can access.

meeting_id.description: Identifier of the Meeting this topic will be created under or updated within.

meeting_topic.description: Attributes for the meeting topic to create or update.

description.description: Rich-text (HTML) description of the topic. Markup is sanitized before it is stored.

due_date.description: Date by which the topic should be resolved.

status.description: Workflow state to set on the topic. Constrained to the values in the enum.

minutes.description: Rich-text (HTML) meeting minutes for the topic. Markup is sanitized before it is stored.

is_private.description: When true, restricts the topic to assignees and users with Admin access to the Meetings tool.

closed_at.description: Timestamp when the topic was closed. Managed automatically when status becomes `Closed`.

priority.description: Priority to assign to the topic. Constrained to the values in the enum; an empty string clears the priority.

added_under_agenda.description: Whether the topic was added while the Meeting was in agenda mode. Defaults to true.

meeting_wide_number.description: Sequential number of the topic across the whole Meeting, used to build the topic's outline number.

meeting_category_id.description: Identifier of the meeting category to place this topic under.

assignment_ids.description:
Login Information (user) IDs of the Project users to assign to this topic.

Setting `meeting_topic[assignment_ids]` to "none" erases assignments.

attachments.description:
Files to attach to the topic.
